encode_bbox_deltas: encode source bounding boxes into delta coordinates relative to ground truth boxes using LegacyDeltaXYWHBBoxCoder
decode_bbox_deltas: decode predicted delta coordinates back to bounding boxes using LegacyDeltaXYWHBBoxCoder with optional shape clipping
compute_bbox2delta: compute delta transformations from proposals to ground truth boxes using legacy_bbox2delta with means and stds normalization
apply_delta2bbox: apply encoded deltas to shift and scale base ROI boxes using legacy_delta2bbox with aspect ratio clipping
register_bbox_coder: register LegacyDeltaXYWHBBoxCoder in the MMDet bbox coder registry for compatibility with MMDet V1.x models
